sm: The Daily Wire hosts react to a series of clips criticizing Thanksgiving. The first claims the holiday was a setup for genocide, and the hosts answer that the real history is more interesting, noting that the Wampanoag leader Massasoit allied with Plymouth to strengthen his nation, warned the settlers of attacks, and was nursed back to health by the English, until a successor, King Philip, wrongly believed they had killed his brother. They also say some Native Americans owned black slaves. Next they joke through a vegan appeal about slaughtered turkeys, then a comedian who dislikes turkey and pumpkin pie, agreeing on turkey but defending the pie. The last clip, about mass deportation ruining a family visit, draws a reply citing victims of illegal immigration and urging him to be nice to his mother.
